PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind

PrincipalRef.description: A compact reference to a principal, embedded in commands and audit records.
PrincipalRef.title: PrincipalRef

VisionTask.description: What AI assist is asked to do.
VisionTask.title: VisionTask

description: Payload of ``vision.proposal.created``: a maneuver waits for a user's approval.

action.description: The default option, what an approval without a choice executes. `drive`: the drive steps; `return_to_dock`: the normal dock command, the mower drives home on its mapped paths by itself; `resume`: the optional drive steps, then the paused mowing job continues (`resume_mow`). With `alternative_action` set this is the rule based fallback and the model's low-confidence recommendation is the alternative.
action.title: Action

alternative_action.description: The model's low-confidence recommendation offered next to the fallback `action`; the user picks one in MowDeck. Null: only `action` is offered.
alternative_action.title: Alternative Action

error_code.description: With trigger `error`: the mower's error code that started the analysis.
error_code.title: Error Code

expires_at.description: Approval is refused after this time.
expires_at.title: Expires At

fallback.description: `action` is the rule based return to dock fallback, not the model's recommendation (it applies: the mower is in a mapped area linked to the dock).
fallback.title: Fallback

link.description: App path of the proposal, e.g. `/mowers/<id>?assist=<id>`.
link.title: Link

low_confidence.description: The model's recommendation is offered although its confidence is below the threshold: as `action`, or as `alternative_action` next to the fallback.
low_confidence.title: Low Confidence

steps.description: Number of proposed drive steps (0 for `return_to_dock`; `resume` may have some before the job continues).
steps.title: Steps

trigger.description: `manual` (a user asked) or `error` (started automatically by the error).

title: VisionProposalCreated
